title: The 10 Best Toaster Ovens for Baking
h1: The 10 Best Toaster Ovens for Baking
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for toaster ovens for baking, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at toaster ovens for baking using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville BOV845BSS Smart Oven Pro
products.blurb: Key specs: Element IQ, 12-slice, Slow cook.
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Breville BOV800XL Smart Oven
strengths: Same Element IQ system as the BOV845BSS at a slightly lower price
Fits a 12-inch pizza or standard cookie sheet

products.name: Cuisinart TOB-135 Deluxe Convection Toaster Oven
products.blurb: Key specs: Exact Heat sensor, Convection, Under $100.

products.name: Panasonic FlashXpress NB-G110P Toaster Oven

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
